name: Winds of Rath
oracle_text: Destroy all creatures that aren't enchanted. They can't be regenerated.
blocked_sentences: Destroy all creatures that aren't enchanted.

needs.what: a selector key matching a permanent that is (or, negated, is not) enchanted -- i.e. has one or more Auras attached to it, controlled by any player -- e.g. `enchanted: false` on a destroy-all selector
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `attached` matches only the permanent the ability's own source is attached to; `modified` also counts counters and Equipment and only Auras you control; no selector key reads whether any Aura is attached to the object, so `destroy` with `no_regeneration` cannot spare enchanted creatures
